name: protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 2

function.text: PTPN2 encodes tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 2. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine phosphatase activity and non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. It participates in erythrocyte differentiation and glucose homeostasis.
